ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio; the visible surface is approximately 98% low-intensity (black/dark gray) with high-intensity (white) pixels localized strictly to surface scarring and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) are spatially distributed primarily across the medial and lateral regions of the left lobe. High-intensity, high-relief clusters (barnacles) are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a clearly defined central vertex dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency serrations with small-amplitude variations (nicks) concentrated on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits a smoother, more continuous linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upwards from the median notch, terminating in a sharp dorsal-facing hook at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density detection of white circular/annular pixel clusters (rosettes) on the left lobe; more dispersed and isolated circular marks are visible on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, unaligned light-colored linear pixel disruptions (scratches) concentrated on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant accumulation of sessile barnacles (Coronula diadema) at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive white circular scarring consistent with past parasite or barnacle attachment across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips of the flukes are heavily encrusted with barnacle colonies, creating irregular, high-contrast, three-dimensional topography distinct from the fluke's natural edge.
